about: How Excel works, in our own words, learned from the official Microsoft documentation first and checked against real users' problems. Causes -> the complaints they explain -> the fact in the file that proves them. The reasoning (app/mind/reason.py) uses this map; it never answers from it without the proof.

total_wrong.cues: (total|sum|grand total|jod|jodd|average|avg|balance|tally)\w*\b.{0,40}\b(wrong|galat|incorrect|not (match|matching|correct|right|tally|adding)|off|short|less|kam|zyada|more than|mismatch|differ|0\b|zero|nahi (aa|ho|mil)|not working)|\b(wrong|galat|incorrect)\b.{0,25}\b(total|sum|jod|average)|(not|nahi) (adding|add ho|jud|jod)|doesn'?t add up|missing (from|in) (the )?(total|sum)|sum (karne|kar) par|tally nahi

lookup_fails.en: the lookup can't find the values
lookup_fails.hi: lookup value nahi dhoond pa raha

wrong_value.en: the lookup brings the wrong value
wrong_value.hi: lookup galat value la raha hai

sort_wrong.en: sorting or filtering by date/number goes wrong

text_in_totals.title_en: {count} amount(s) inside your totals {are} saved as text
text_in_totals.title_hi: Total ke andar {count} amount text ke roop mein save hain
text_in_totals.why_en: SUM and AVERAGE add only real numbers and quietly skip text. These cells look like numbers but are text (usually from a copy-paste or an export), so they are left out: the total is {impact_text} short.
text_in_totals.why_hi: SUM aur AVERAGE sirf asli numbers jodte hain, text ko chupchaap chhod dete hain. Ye cells number jaise dikhte hain par text hain (aksar copy-paste ya export se), isliye total mein nahi jude: total {impact_text} kam aa raha hai.
text_in_totals.fix_en: Turn them into real numbers (value kept the same).
text_in_totals.fix_hi: Inhe asli number bana deta hoon (value wahi rahegi).
text_in_totals.prevent_en: When pasting from another system, use Paste Special > Values, or Data > Text to Columns on the pasted column.
text_in_totals.prevent_hi: Doosre system se paste karte waqt Paste Special > Values use karo, ya pasted column pe Data > Text to Columns.

short_range.title_en: The total's range stops before the end of the data
short_range.title_hi: Total ki range data khatam hone se pehle ruk jaati hai
short_range.why_en: A SUM only adds the cells inside its range. Rows were added after the formula was written, so {first} adds {range} but the numbers carry on in {left_out}: {rows} row(s) worth {impact_text} are missing.
short_range.why_hi: SUM sirf apni range ke andar ke cells jodta hai. Formula likhne ke baad rows add hui, isliye {first} sirf {range} jodta hai, jabki numbers {left_out} tak hain: {rows} row ({impact_text}) chhoot gayi.
short_range.fix_en: Stretch the range to cover all the rows ({fixed}).
short_range.fix_hi: Range ko saari rows tak badha deta hoon ({fixed}).
short_range.prevent_en: Keep the data as a Table (Ctrl+T): totals on a Table grow by themselves when you add rows.
short_range.prevent_hi: Data ko Table bana do (Ctrl+T): Table ke total nayi rows apne aap jod lete hain.

hidden_in_totals.title_en: Hidden rows are still being added
hidden_in_totals.title_hi: Chhupi hui rows bhi jud rahi hain
hidden_in_totals.why_en: SUM adds hidden and filtered-out rows too. {first} covers {hidden_rows} hidden row(s), so it is bigger than what you see on screen.
hidden_in_totals.why_hi: SUM chhupi aur filter se hati rows bhi jodta hai. {first} mein {hidden_rows} chhupi row hain, isliye total screen pe dikh rahe se zyada hai.
hidden_in_totals.fix_en: If you want only the visible rows, use SUBTOTAL(109, range) instead of SUM. Tell me and I'll change it.
hidden_in_totals.fix_hi: Sirf dikhne wali rows chahiye to SUM ki jagah SUBTOTAL(109, range). Bolo to main badal doon.
hidden_in_totals.confirm_en: The total then matches the visible rows.
hidden_in_totals.confirm_hi: Phir total dikhne wali rows se match karega.
hidden_in_totals.prevent_en: Use SUBTOTAL or AGGREGATE for totals on filtered lists.
hidden_in_totals.prevent_hi: Filter wali list pe SUBTOTAL ya AGGREGATE use karo.

typed_over_formula.title_en: {count} cell(s) in a formula column {were} typed over with a fixed number
typed_over_formula.title_hi: Formula wale column mein {count} cell pe number type kar diya gaya hai
typed_over_formula.why_en: The rest of the column calculates, but these cells hold a typed number, so they never change when the inputs change: {cells}.
typed_over_formula.why_hi: Baaki column calculate karta hai, par in cells mein type kiya number hai, isliye input badalne par ye nahi badalte: {cells}.
typed_over_formula.fix_en: Put the column's formula back in those cells.
typed_over_formula.fix_hi: Un cells mein column ka formula wapas laga deta hoon.
typed_over_formula.confirm_en: Those cells then change with their row like the rest.
typed_over_formula.confirm_hi: Phir ye cells baaki ki tarah apni row ke saath badlenge.
typed_over_formula.prevent_en: Protect formula columns (Review > Protect Sheet, with input cells unlocked).
typed_over_formula.prevent_hi: Formula columns ko protect karo (Review > Protect Sheet, input cells unlock rakh ke).

manual_calc.title_en: The workbook is set to calculate manually
manual_calc.title_hi: Workbook manual calculation pe set hai
manual_calc.why_en: With calculation on Manual, Excel doesn't recalculate when values change, so formulas keep showing old results until you press F9.
manual_calc.why_hi: Calculation Manual pe ho to value badalne par Excel dobara calculate nahi karta, isliye F9 dabane tak formula purana result dikhate hain.
manual_calc.fix_en: Switch the workbook back to Automatic calculation.
manual_calc.fix_hi: Workbook ko wapas Automatic calculation pe kar deta hoon.
manual_calc.confirm_en: Change any input: the results update straight away.
manual_calc.confirm_hi: Koi bhi input badlo: result turant badlega.
manual_calc.prevent_en: Manual mode travels with the first workbook you open in a session; check Formulas > Calculation Options if it comes back.
manual_calc.prevent_hi: Manual mode session mein pehli khuli workbook se aata hai; dobara ho to Formulas > Calculation Options dekho.

lookup_spaces.title_en: {count} lookup(s) failing because of extra spaces or different spelling
lookup_spaces.title_hi: {count} lookup extra space ya alag spelling ki wajah se fail
lookup_spaces.why_en: A lookup needs an exact match. {first} looks for "{looks_for}" but the list has "{there}": to Excel these are different values, so it returns #N/A.
lookup_spaces.why_hi: Lookup ko bilkul same value chahiye. {first} "{looks_for}" dhoondta hai par list mein "{there}" hai: Excel ke liye ye alag hain, isliye #N/A.
lookup_spaces.fix_en: Remove the extra spaces on both sides so the values match.
lookup_spaces.fix_hi: Dono taraf ke extra space hata deta hoon taaki value match ho.
lookup_spaces.confirm_en: Those lookups show their values instead of #N/A.
lookup_spaces.confirm_hi: Un lookups mein #N/A ki jagah value aa jayegi.
lookup_spaces.prevent_en: Clean pasted lists with TRIM before looking them up.
lookup_spaces.prevent_hi: Paste ki list ko lookup se pehle TRIM se saaf karo.

lookup_type.title_en: {count} lookup(s) failing because a number is compared with the same number saved as text
lookup_type.title_hi: {count} lookup fail: number ko text wale number se milaya ja raha hai
lookup_type.why_en: To a lookup, the number 1001 and the text "1001" are different. {first} looks for {looks_for} and the list holds it the other way, so it returns #N/A.
lookup_type.why_hi: Lookup ke liye number 1001 aur text "1001" alag hain. {first} {looks_for} dhoondta hai aur list mein woh doosre roop mein hai, isliye #N/A.
lookup_type.fix_en: Turn the text numbers into real numbers so both sides are the same type.
lookup_type.fix_hi: Text wale numbers ko asli number bana deta hoon taaki dono taraf same type ho.
lookup_type.confirm_en: Those lookups show their values instead of #N/A.
lookup_type.confirm_hi: Un lookups mein #N/A ki jagah value aa jayegi.
lookup_type.prevent_en: Keep ID/code columns one type in both lists.
lookup_type.prevent_hi: ID/code column dono list mein ek hi type mein rakho.

lookup_missing.title_en: {count} value(s) really {are}n't in the lookup list
lookup_missing.title_hi: {count} value lookup list mein sach mein nahi hain
lookup_missing.why_en: I checked the list itself: "{looks_for}" (from {first}) isn't in {in} at all, not even with different spaces or as text. #N/A is correct here: the list is missing those entries.
lookup_missing.why_hi: Maine list khud check ki: "{looks_for}" ({first} se) {in} mein hai hi nahi, alag space ya text roop mein bhi nahi. Yahan #N/A sahi hai: list mein ye entries nahi hain.
lookup_missing.fix_en: Add the missing entries to the list (or check the spelling at the source). To show a blank or a note instead of #N/A, wrap it in IFNA(..., "Not found").
lookup_missing.fix_hi: List mein missing entries daalo (ya source pe spelling check karo). #N/A ki jagah khaali ya note dikhana ho to IFNA(..., "Not found") lagao.
lookup_missing.confirm_en: Once added, the lookup finds them.
lookup_missing.confirm_hi: Add karte hi lookup unhe dhoond lega.
lookup_missing.prevent_en: Use a dropdown (Data Validation) from the master list so only existing values can be typed.
lookup_missing.prevent_hi: Master list se dropdown (Data Validation) banao taaki sirf maujood value type ho.

approx_lookup.title_hi: {count} lookup approximate match use kar rahe hain
approx_lookup.why_en: Without FALSE (or 0) at the end, VLOOKUP and MATCH look for the nearest value in a sorted list. On an unsorted list they return a wrong row or #N/A. Example: {first}.
approx_lookup.why_hi: Aakhir mein FALSE (ya 0) na ho to VLOOKUP aur MATCH sorted list mein sabse paas wali value dhoondte hain. Unsorted list pe galat row ya #N/A dete hain. Jaise: {first}.
approx_lookup.fix_hi: Inhe exact match pe kar deta hoon ({fixed}).
approx_lookup.confirm_en: Each lookup returns the row with exactly that value.
approx_lookup.confirm_hi: Har lookup bilkul usi value wali row layega.
approx_lookup.prevent_en: Always end VLOOKUP with FALSE, or use XLOOKUP (exact by default).
approx_lookup.prevent_hi: VLOOKUP hamesha FALSE ke saath likho, ya XLOOKUP use karo (default exact).

broken_refs.title_en: {count} formula(s) pointing to cells that were deleted (#REF!)
broken_refs.title_hi: {count} formula delete hue cells ko point kar rahe hain (#REF!)
broken_refs.why_en: A formula keeps the address of the cells it uses. When a row, column or sheet it used is deleted, the address is gone and Excel writes #REF! in its place: {cells}.
broken_refs.why_hi: Formula apne cells ka address yaad rakhta hai. Jo row, column ya sheet woh use karta tha delete ho jaye to address gayab, aur Excel wahan #REF! likh deta hai: {cells}.
broken_refs.fix_en: Rebuild each one from the same formula in the neighbouring rows.
broken_refs.fix_hi: Har ek ko aas-paas ki rows ke same formula se dobara bana deta hoon.
broken_refs.confirm_en: No #REF! left; I list every rebuilt formula in the Changes sheet.
broken_refs.confirm_hi: Koi #REF! nahi bachega; har badla formula Changes sheet mein milega.
broken_refs.prevent_en: Clear contents instead of deleting rows that formulas use, or use whole-column references.
broken_refs.prevent_hi: Formula wali rows delete karne ki jagah content clear karo, ya poore column ka reference lo.

div0.title_en: {count} formula(s) dividing by zero or an empty cell (#DIV/0!)
div0.title_hi: {count} formula zero ya khaali cell se divide kar rahe hain (#DIV/0!)
div0.why_en: Dividing by 0 or by an empty cell has no answer, so Excel shows #DIV/0!. Any total over these cells shows the error too: {cells}.
div0.why_hi: 0 ya khaali cell se divide ka koi jawab nahi, isliye Excel #DIV/0! dikhata hai. In cells ka total bhi error dikhayega: {cells}.
div0.fix_en: Fill the missing value, or wrap the formula: =IF(B2=0, 0, A2/B2). Tell me and I'll do it on the file.
div0.fix_hi: Missing value bharo, ya formula ko aise lapeto: =IF(B2=0, 0, A2/B2). Bolo to file pe kar doon.
div0.confirm_en: The error is gone and totals work again.
div0.confirm_hi: Error hat jayega aur total phir chalega.
div0.prevent_en: Guard every division with IF or IFERROR.
div0.prevent_hi: Har division ko IF ya IFERROR se bachao.

value_err.title_hi: {count} formula text pe hisaab laga rahe hain (#VALUE!)
value_err.why_en: +, -, * and / need numbers. When one of the cells holds text (even a space), Excel can't calculate and shows #VALUE!: {cells}.
value_err.why_hi: +, -, * aur / ko number chahiye. Kisi cell mein text ho (ek space bhi), to Excel calculate nahi kar pata aur #VALUE! dikhata hai: {cells}.
value_err.fix_en: Turn text numbers into numbers and clear stray spaces; SUM() instead of + skips text safely.
value_err.fix_hi: Text numbers ko number banao aur faltu space hatao; + ki jagah SUM() text ko safely chhod deta hai.
value_err.prevent_en: Keep number columns free of text and spaces.
value_err.prevent_hi: Number columns mein text aur space mat rakho.

name_err.title_en: {count} formula(s) using a name Excel doesn't know (#NAME?)
name_err.title_hi: {count} formula aisa naam use kar rahe hain jo Excel nahi jaanta (#NAME?)
name_err.why_en: #NAME? means a misspelt function, a missing quote around text, or a function your Excel version doesn't have (XLOOKUP needs Excel 2021/365): {cells}.
name_err.why_hi: #NAME? ka matlab: function ki spelling galat, text ke aas-paas quote missing, ya aapke Excel version mein woh function nahi (XLOOKUP ko Excel 2021/365 chahiye): {cells}.
name_err.fix_en: Correct the spelling or quotes; on older Excel I'll give the INDEX/MATCH version.
name_err.fix_hi: Spelling ya quote theek karo; purane Excel pe main INDEX/MATCH wala version de dunga.
name_err.prevent_en: Pick functions from the formula autocomplete list.
name_err.prevent_hi: Function formula autocomplete list se chuno.

duplicate_rows.title_hi: {count} row do baar daali gayi hain
duplicate_rows.why_en: The same record appears more than once, so counts and totals include it each time.
duplicate_rows.why_hi: Ek hi record ek se zyada baar hai, isliye count aur total use har baar jod lete hain.
duplicate_rows.fix_en: Remove the repeated rows (the first copy stays; the removed ones are listed).
duplicate_rows.fix_hi: Dohrai rows hata deta hoon (pehli copy rahegi; hatayi gayi list mein milengi).
duplicate_rows.prevent_en: Use a unique ID column and Data > Remove Duplicates before reports.
duplicate_rows.prevent_hi: Unique ID column rakho aur report se pehle Data > Remove Duplicates.

text_dates.title_hi: {count} date text ke roop mein save hain
text_dates.why_en: Real dates are numbers underneath, so they sort and filter by time. Text dates sort letter by letter ("10/01" before "2/01") and date filters skip them: {cells}.
text_dates.why_hi: Asli date andar se number hoti hai, isliye time ke hisaab se sort/filter hoti hai. Text date akshar ke hisaab se sort hoti hai ("10/01" pehle "2/01" se) aur date filter unhe chhod deta hai: {cells}.
text_dates.fix_en: Convert them to real dates (Data > Text to Columns > Date, choose DMY or MDY). Tell me the order and I'll do it.
text_dates.fix_hi: Inhe asli date banao (Data > Text to Columns > Date, DMY ya MDY chuno). Order batao to main kar doon.
text_dates.confirm_en: Sorting and date filters then include every row in the right order.
text_dates.confirm_hi: Phir sort aur date filter har row ko sahi order mein lenge.
text_dates.prevent_en: Type dates in one format, or use a date picker/validation.
text_dates.prevent_hi: Date ek hi format mein likho, ya validation lagao.

spaces.why_en: "Delhi" and "Delhi " look the same but are different values, so filters, COUNTIF and pivots treat them as two items.
spaces.why_hi: "Delhi" aur "Delhi " ek jaise dikhte hain par alag value hain, isliye filter, COUNTIF aur pivot inhe do alag item maante hain.
spaces.confirm_en: Each item shows once in filters and counts.
spaces.confirm_hi: Filter aur count mein har item ek hi baar dikhega.
spaces.prevent_hi: Paste kiya data TRIM se saaf karo.

text_numbers.title_hi: {count} number text ke roop mein save hain
text_numbers.why_en: Numbers saved as text sort as words (100 before 20) and maths skips them.
text_numbers.why_hi: Text wale number shabdon ki tarah sort hote hain (100 pehle 20 se) aur hisaab unhe chhod deta hai.
text_numbers.fix_hi: Inhe asli number bana deta hoon.
text_numbers.confirm_en: They sort and add as numbers.
text_numbers.confirm_hi: Phir number ki tarah sort aur jodenge.
text_numbers.prevent_en: Paste Special > Values when copying from other systems.
text_numbers.prevent_hi: Doosre system se copy karte waqt Paste Special > Values.
